wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 49.27392,-121.23150: Hwy 3 along the N edge; the curved RV rows fill the SE quarter of the resort behind the clubhouse and pool, a cabin row along the S edge; a braided gravel river channel lies beyond a treed strip ~25 m past the last rows, with no open water in the frame; not waterfront (pin moved from Google's clubhouse point onto the RV rows)

operator grounds map (numbered sites) + satellite (Esri z17/z18, spring, lake frozen) at 52.1684,-124.0686: the map puts RV sites 7-10 in a row on the lake side of the outer loop road along the Puntzi Lake shore with only the beach between; the frames show the camp ground sloping to a continuous open grass/beach apron ~15-25 m wide at the water's edge, no road, treeline or building row between; lakefront

operator site map + satellite (Esri z17/z18, summer) at 52.4066,-126.5000: the campground fills a ~100-140 m forested strip between the Bella Coola River (W) and Saloompt River Rd (E), under continuous conifer canopy with no pads resolvable; the hand-drawn map numbers sites 1-27 but draws no river and marks no RV site at the bank; 'riverside campsites' is marketing only; default down; not waterfront

operator numbered site map + satellite (Esri z17/z18, 2021-07-03, the only capture and the campground's opening year) at 52.3903,-126.5535: the map draws two small creeks crossing the property and puts partly-serviced (20A) RV sites 21 and 23 directly on the upper creek's bank (tent sites 18-19 on the lower one); the property S of Hwy 20 is under continuous canopy where neither creek nor pads can be resolved, so the satellite can't veto the map, and neither creek shows as a canopy gap (narrow); the Bella Coola River is ~275 m N beyond the highway and fields; creekside

operator site map (Feb 2026) + satellite (Esri z17/z18, autumn) at 50.3106,-119.1879: a lane lined with RVs runs through dense forest S of the BX Creek ravine, which lies ~100+ m N in deep shade; the map draws no creek at any of its 56 sites and sends BX Falls off the property by trail; not waterfront (pin on the RV row at Campspot's park coordinate; Google's point is on Tillicum Rd ~240 m W)

satellite (Esri z15/z17/z18, summer) at 49.2115,-119.9840: the pow-wow grounds (round arbour, cook house) sit in open pine parkland with dirt-track loops; the river channel (~10-15 m) runs ~130 m NW of the arbour with no pads or units at its edge (the dark area SE in the z17 frame is mountain shadow, not water); no site map; default down; not waterfront

satellite (Esri z17/z18, summer) at 51.8634,-120.8697: the 6 RV sites are the gravel loop of angled pull-in spurs N of the ranch house; the stream runs E-W ~150-185 m S of them beyond an open lawn, a lane, garden plots, two cabins and a bank strip of shrubs and trees; not waterfront

operator park map + satellite (Esri z17/z18; Wayback 2022-05-11 Vernon 7.5 cm ortho and 2025-11-06 WV02 at z19) at 50.2985,-119.2565: the map puts the westernmost row (full-service 52-64, water/power 65-93) on the Swan Lake shore with the one-way lane on its land side; the 2025 frames show that row of RVs (built since 2022, the lane moved inland) backing W toward the water ~20-30 m away across a strip of willow clumps with mown lawn running to the water (2022 ortho), no road or other use; lakefront

satellite (Esri z17/z18 2025-04-14; Wayback 2024-06-08 and 2021-10-19) at 50.5056,-119.8329: the campground lies on the pine slope E of Hwy 97; Monte Lake is ~90 m W across the highway and a strip of lakeside houses, and the units sit under dense pines with no confirmable open view; highway between; not waterfront

operator resort map (v6.2) + satellite (Esri z17/z18, summer) at 50.9961,-118.6452: the serviced loops and the forested loop lie between the Trans-Canada and an active CP rail line; Crazy Creek drops through a canopy-covered gorge along the E side ~55+ m from the nearest lanes with a tree strip drawn between it and its closest (dry/small-RV) sites; the Eagle River is S beyond the rail line and Taft Road (seasonal beach access across the tracks); default down; not waterfront
